fixed.reason: What you changed, in one line
changed_members: the id of each member the fix changed
removed_members: the id of each member the fix removed from the map

evidence.starting_at: text that occurs once in the fixed passage

fixed.reassessment: How the changed member reads now, and any check you ran on it

recorded_at.path: where the project keeps the write-up, or set recorded_at null if none
recorded_at.starting_at: the line that states the problem

deferred.waits_on: Whom it waits on, to decide what, in one line, or null

accepted.reason: Why the project keeps it as it is

disagreed.reason: Why the finding does not hold
